item.tetra.scroll.omniscient.details:
Core · Pivot
Allows the holder to invoke all 'scroll techniques' that exist or have ever existed in the world — whether forbidden lore from burned texts, divination rituals of lost civilizations, or future arts yet to be invented, all can be drawn from this scroll as if from a neighbor.
It does not provide answers, but rather 'the vision to see all answers.' In the holder's eyes, the underlying fabric of the world will appear; all things are no longer phenomena, but lines to be dissected and redrawn.
Appearance · Brief
This scroll is neither silk nor paper; to touch it is to caress the void, and to gaze upon it is to see all phenomena flowing upon its surface.
When first unrolled, it is silent, but once opened, countless whispers cascade from unknowable places, like the roar of celestial stars and planets compressed into a hum that mortal eardrums can barely endure.
The text upon it is not written, but woven from threads of causality; each stroke points to a truth either already hidden or not yet come to pass.
